sub_answers.text: UEFA club coefficients are calculated as the sum of a club's points from Champions League, Europa League and Conference League over five seasons or 20% of the association coefficient over the same period, whichever is higher [d1800094s9p0]. Clubs receive two points for a win and one point for a draw in the main stages of UEFA club competitions, with bonus points applied for entering the Champions League group stage and for qualifying to knockout stages, while Europa League and Conference League bonus points provide minimum participation allowances [d1800094s9p0]. Results decided after extra time count as wins/draws for points, while penalty shoot-outs are recorded as draws for coefficient purposes [d1800094s9p0]. Qualifying-round results are included in coefficient calculations only if the club is eliminated in one of those rounds, otherwise qualifying results are treated differently for association coefficient calculations and may be halved [d1800094s9p0].

UEFA club coefficients are the sum of points earned by a club in the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League over the previous five seasons or 20% of the association coefficient over the same period, whichever is higher [d1800094s9p0].
Clubs earn two points for a win and one point for a draw in the main stages of UEFA club competitions, with results after extra-time counted and penalty shoot-outs treated as draws for coefficient purposes [d1800094s9p0].
Qualifying round results are counted only if the club is eliminated in one of the rounds, otherwise qualifying results are halved for association calculations and clubs do not receive points for elimination in Champions League or Europa League qualifying because those clubs move into other competitions and receive points there [d1800094s9p0].
UEFA association coefficients determine the number of clubs an association can enter into UEFA competitions and which rounds those clubs enter, with the ranking based on club results over five seasons and using season points divided by the number of participating teams, plus bonus points for certain achievements [d1800094s1p0].
